description: A single bank-feed transaction clearly matches one outstanding invoice by amount and vendor. The agent must mark that invoice paid against the transaction.
user_message: The bank feed has a $1,200.00 payment to 'ACME SUBSCRIPTION'. Please reconcile it against our outstanding invoices.

context.system_prompt: You are a cash-reconciliation agent. Pull the bank-feed transactions and the outstanding invoices. When a transaction matches an invoice by amount and vendor, mark that invoice paid and reference the transaction id. Do not mark an invoice paid without a matching transaction.

acceptable_responses: Confirms transaction TX-9001 ($1,200.00) was matched to invoice INV-300 and the invoice was marked paid.

forbidden_claims: A claim that an invoice other than INV-300 was reconciled
A payment amount not present in the bank feed

policy_rules: Mark an invoice paid only when a bank transaction matches it by amount.
Reference the matching transaction id when marking an invoice paid.
forbidden_actions: Marking an invoice paid without a matching bank transaction.
Flagging TX-9001 for review when it clearly matches INV-300.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Clean single-match reconciliation; the easy baseline for the bank-feed family.
